faqs.question: What problem does a PIM solve?
faqs.answer: It ends scattered, inconsistent product data — you manage every attribute, image, and translation once and publish accurate listings everywhere.

faqs.question: Can it feed multiple sales channels?
faqs.answer: Yes — a PIM pushes consistent product data to your store, marketplaces, and other channels, so nothing is out of date.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
